decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	With appropriate safeguarding conditions, it is considered that the proposed installation of a six bicycle lockers would have due regard for the site characteristics of 7 St John's Road, Isleworth, are in accordance with the relevant Policies of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan (adopted December 2003).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on or before five years from the date of permission when the use shall cease.
Condition : 5 - The six bicycle lockers hereby granted planning permission shall have an exterior colour of navy blue.
description: Installation of bicycle lockers to existing site.
